title: workroom.bats' 0216 arms plant lines to prove their scans, a control on a check hv banned
body:
tests/unit/workroom.bats' four 0216 arms (handles, credits, rulings, pointers) each plant a file of lines the scan must flag and a file of innocent lines it must pass, before they scan the shipped tree, and the file's header says every arm "proves on every run that it can go red". A planted line that proves a scan is a control on a check, which hv banned on 2026-10-08 (no tests of tests, no controls that check checks) and decision 68 kept out of critic legs on 2026-10-25. The pattern is on main from 0216 (108c46d5), and 0242's names arm was ruled to carry no plant (vc, 2026-10-28), so the file now holds both. Filed by vc on 2026-10-28; low, and not in 0.1.16.

## Fix

Each 0216 arm scans the shipped tree alone, through _workroom_files and _workroom_hits, and fails naming every hit by path and line. _workroom_plant and _workroom_arm's control half go, and the header says what each arm refuses by its shape and what it does not read, without claiming a run proves it can go red.

## Done when

1. No arm in workroom.bats plants a line, and no helper that plants one remains.
2. The landing suite passes under BSD and GNU, with the tree scans and help, and CI is green on the pushed head.

## Resolution

Closed as not doing, on hv's ruling of 2026-10-28: "defer E to 0.1.17, close 0274 and 0278" (relayed verbatim by molt-vc at 18:11Z by date -u), after vc's triage rated it P4. No code changed.
